name: LIBERTY MEDIA CORPORATION

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-26), EPS note, 'Series A, Series B and Series C Liberty Formula One Common Stock' WASO table: Diluted WASO 258M for 2025 (basic 250M + 8M potentially dilutive shares); same table shows 243M for 2024 and 240M for 2023. EDGAR companyfacts carries no undimensioned diluted share series after Q1 2016 for CIK 1560385 (the filer tags share counts with class/group dimensions the aggregated facts drop).
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — diluted shares missing for 2023, 2024, 2025 in companyfacts. The consolidated continuing operations in the FY2025 10-K are the Formula One Group (Liberty Live and Liberty SiriusXM are presented as discontinued operations), so the Formula One Group diluted WASO is the denominator that matches the engine's continuing-ops OE numerator and the FWONA/FWONK price. The engine applies this single value to every missing period; the 3-yr median OE total is the FY2025 figure itself (OE totals $462M/$768M/$1,976M for 2024/2025/2023), so the normalized base is FY2025 OE divided by the FY2025 diluted count exactly, with no cross-year distortion in the base.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-26), EPS note, 'Series A, Series B and Series C Liberty Formula One Common Stock' WASO table: Diluted WASO 258M for 2025 (basic 250M + 8M potentially dilutive shares); same table shows 243M for 2024 and 240M for 2023. EDGAR companyfacts carries no undimensioned diluted share series after Q1 2016 for CIK 1560385 (the filer tags share counts with class/group dimensions the aggregated facts drop).); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 5.3x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
